papers.title: γ‐Ray Controlled Topological Evolution of Binders for Stable and Activated Li─S Battery Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT γ‐ray irradiation facilitates controllable, clean, and reagent‐free cross‐linking of polymer networks without side reactions. Leveraging these merits, we precisely tune the irradiation dose to engineer a three‐dimensional (3D) poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA) binder network for lithium‐sulfur (Li─S) batteries. By integrating multiscale synchrotron radiation X‐ray characterization techniques, we elucidate how the γ‐ray irradiation dose governs the 3D network structure and consequently regulates sulfur cathode stability and sulfur reaction kinetics without using catalysts. The optimal dose of 3 kGy yields a favorable PVA binder network featuring a dense framework, favorable connectivity, and homogeneous spatial distribution. The interpenetrating structure composed of binder, sulfur, and conductive agent leads to coupling of the mechanical architecture with the electron‐conductive network, accompanied by high‐flux lithium‐ion diffusion, thereby relieving cathode volume variation and promoting sulfur interconversion kinetics. This resulting sulfur cathode delivers a capacity decay rate of only 0.045% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 1 C. Moreover, a 1.23 Ah‐level pouch cell fabricated with the 3 kGy dose‐enabled PVA (3‐PVA) binder achieves an energy density of 390.2 Wh kg −1 . This study highlights γ‐ray irradiation as a clean and controllable strategy to engineer binder topological structure, disclosing dose‐dependent structure–property relationships that govern electrode mechanics and electrochemistry.
papers.summary_ko: 감마선 조사량을 정밀하게 조절하여 리튬-황(Li-S) 전지용 PVA 바인더의 3차원 가교 네트워크 구조를 제어했다. 최적 조사량(3 kGy)에서 형성된 조밀하고 균일한 바인더 네트워크는 전자 전도 경로와 기계적 구조를 결합시켜 황 양극의 부피 변화를 완화하고 전환 반응 속도를 향상시켰다. 이 바인더를 적용한 황 양극은 1C에서 1000회 사이클 동안 사이클당 0.045%의 낮은 용량 감쇠율을 보였으며, 1.23 Ah급 파우치셀에서 390.2 Wh/kg의 에너지 밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: Unraveling the Origins of C‐Rate Dependent Capacity Decay in Fe‐Mn‐Based Prussian Blue Cathodes for Sodium Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Prussian blue analogues (PBAs), especially low‐cost Mn‐doped Fe‐based PBAs, demonstrate significant potential for power‐type sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), owing to their open framework and high theoretical capacity (∼170 mAh g −1 ). However, their capacity decay mechanisms, particularly under rapid charge/discharge conditions, remain insufficiently understood, hindering their practical implementation in high‐power energy storage systems. Here, we systematically investigate the failure mechanisms of Mn‐doped Fe‐based PBAs through multiple in/ex situ characterizations of Mn‐doped Fe‐PBA cathodes cycled under various current densities. Our analysis reveals that there are several pathways induce electrode degradation at high rate: (1) transition metal dissolution that disrupts redox‐active sites, (2) mechanical degradation that impairs electrode kinetics under high‐rate conditions, (3) severe and rapid Na dendrite growth, and (4) interfacial side reactions that generate a thick cathode‐electrolyte interphase layer. Rather than viewing transition metal dissolution and mechanical degradation as isolated degradation pathways, this study reveals that capacity collapse at 10 C is fundamentally driven by the intrinsic kinetic mismatch and mechanical failure, offering key insights for the design of durable, high‐power PBA‐based SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: Mn을 도핑한 Fe계 프러시안 블루 유사체(PBA)를 소듐이온전지 양극으로 사용했을 때 고율 조건에서 발생하는 용량 감쇠 메커니즘을 in/ex situ 분석으로 규명했다. 전이금속 용해, 기계적 손상, Na 덴드라이트 성장, 계면 부반응 등 여러 저하 경로 중 10C에서의 급격한 용량 붕괴는 본질적인 반응속도 불일치와 기계적 파괴가 근본 원인임을 밝혔다. 이는 내구성 높은 고출력 PBA 양극 설계에 중요한 통찰을 제공한다.

papers.title: Spatially Integrated Intercalation–Conversion Hybrid Cathode for Durable, High‐Capacity Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The fundamental trade‐off between structural stability and high capacity remains a key challenge in Li‐ion battery cathode design, especially in cost‐sensitive, large‐scale applications. Here, we present a spatially integrated intercalation–conversion hybrid cathode that combines LiFePO 4 and sulfur‐based materials within a monolayer architecture. This earth‐abundant composition synchronizes Li‐ion intercalation with the solid‐liquid sulfur conversion reaction: LiFePO 4 serves as a mechanically robust Li host and a chemical regulator that suppresses polysulfide shuttles, while sulfur‐based materials provide high specific capacity. By rationally tailoring the cathode composition and electrolyte solvation chemistry, we reveal how electrolyte–cathode synergistic interactions govern active material utilization, interfacial kinetics, and long‐term stability. The optimized Li‐metal battery delivers stable cycling over 3000 cycles with a low‐capacity decay rate of 0.016% per cycle at 5 C and also demonstrates stable cycling under practical asymmetric cycling protocols. This work provides a new design principle for hybrid cathodes, offering a scalable pathway toward ultra‐durable and high‐capacity Li‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: LiFePO4와 황 기반 물질을 단일층 구조 내에 공간적으로 통합한 인터칼레이션-전환 하이브리드 양극을 제안했다. LiFePO4는 기계적으로 안정적인 리튬 호스트 및 폴리설파이드 셔틀 억제 역할을 하고, 황 기반 물질은 높은 비용량을 제공하여 두 반응을 동기화시켰다. 전해질-양극 조성 최적화를 통해 이 리튬 금속전지는 5C에서 사이클당 0.016%의 낮은 용량 감쇠율로 3000회 이상의 안정적인 사이클링을 달성했다.

papers.title: Beyond Facet Engineering: Dislocation‐Mediated Nucleation Enables Stable Lithium Deposition on Practical Polycrystalline Cu Collectors
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Uniform Li deposition on practical Cu current collectors remains challenging in lithium metal batteries. Despite extensive efforts in facet engineering, achieving homogeneous Li deposition on practical polycrystalline Cu collectors remains elusive, highlighting an incomplete understanding of the structural factors governing Li deposition. Herein, a defect‐mediated interfacial engineering strategy is developed by simultaneously introducing a high density of geometrically necessary dislocations (GNDs) and enriched / textures on commercial electrodeposited Cu foils. Theoretical calculations and experiments reveal that densely distributed dislocations provide thermodynamically favorable Li adsorption sites and abundant preferential heterogeneous nucleation sites, while the enriched / textures promote Li surface diffusion and lateral growth. This combined effect promotes uniform and compact initial Li deposition, guiding path‐dependent deposition evolution and suppressing interfacial heterogeneity. The control experiments further support a key contribution of dislocation defects, while variations in surface chemistry or morphology alone cannot account for the observed performance differences. The optimized Cu foil sustains over 1200 cycles with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.52% ± 0.20% over the final 200 cycles ( n = 4) in Li||Cu cells and improves N/P = 0 Cu||NCM811 full‐cell cycling. This work establishes dislocation‐mediated nucleation and orientation‐regulated growth as a design principle for practical Cu current collectors.
papers.summary_ko: 상용 다결정 Cu 집전체 표면에 전위(dislocation)를 도입하여 리튬 금속전지에서 균일한 Li 증착을 유도하는 전략을 제시했다. 조밀하게 분포된 전위가 열역학적으로 유리한 Li 흡착 및 불균일 핵생성 자리를 제공하고, 특정 결정면 조직이 Li의 표면 확산과 측방 성장을 촉진하여 균일하고 조밀한 초기 Li 증착을 유도함을 이론 계산과 실험으로 입증했다. 최적화된 Cu 집전체는 Li||Cu 셀에서 1200회 이상의 사이클과 평균 99.52%의 쿨롱 효율을 보였다.

papers.title: Anion Co‐Intercalation in Conductive 2D MOFs via π‐d Hybridization for High‐Performance Magnesium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Rechargeable magnesium batteries (RMBs) are a promising post‐lithium battery technology due to abundant magnesium reserves, high volumetric capacity, and dendrite‐free Mg anodes. However, the strong electrostatic interaction between Mg 2+ and inorganic cathode lattices causes high diffusion barriers and sluggish kinetics. To circumvent this, two‐dimensional conductive metal‐organic frameworks (2D c‐MOFs), featuring favorable electronic transport characteristics arising from π‐d hybridization and structural tunability, have attracted widespread attention. This work systematically investigates the electrochemical performance of M 3 (HITP) 2 (M = Co, Ni, Cu; HITP = 2,3,6,7,10,11‐hexaiminotriphenylene) as cathodes for RMBs and reveals the decisive role of the metal center in Mg storage. All three materials achieve synergistic dual‐ion storage through heteroatomic N coordination with Mg 2+ coupled with anion intercalation. Among them, Ni 3 (HITP) 2 demonstrates superior overall performance, arising from its characteristic Ni 2+ d 8 electronic configuration, which facilitates the formation of a stable Ni‐N coordination environment and effective π‐d conjugation. It retains approximately 201 mAh g −1 after 1100 cycles at 1.0 A g −1 , corresponding to a high‐capacity retention of 98.0%. This study elucidates how different metal centers regulate Mg storage in 2D c‐MOFs, providing molecular‐level guidance for designing high‐performance organic cathodes for multivalent‐ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: π-d 혼성화 기반의 2차원 전도성 금속-유기 골격체(MOF)를 마그네슘 전지 양극으로 적용해 금속 중심(Co, Ni, Cu)이 Mg 저장 성능에 미치는 영향을 규명했다. Ni3(HITP)2는 안정적인 Ni-N 배위 환경과 효과적인 π-d 결합으로 세 소재 중 가장 우수한 성능을 보였으며, 1.0 A/g에서 1100회 사이클 후에도 약 201 mAh/g의 용량(98.0% 용량 유지율)을 유지했다.

papers.title: Wireless, optoelectronic, multimodal skin sensor for simultaneous monitoring of mechanical stress and vascular responses
papers.abstract_en: Prolonged mechanical loading and subsequent vascular ischemia drive the development of severe pressure injuries. Effective prevention of irreversible tissue damage requires monitoring both multiaxial mechanical forces and physiological erythema. However, conventional diagnostic tools remain limited by rigid architectures, single parameter detection, and subjective visual assessments. Here, a wireless, battery free optoelectronic multimodal sensor platform provides an integrated framework for tracking posture dependent mechanical loading and localized erythema. The soft, skin conformable device uses geometric light modulation within an isolated optical cavity to quantify normal pressure and biaxial shear stresses. To resolve complex mechanical environments, a deep neural network regression model decouples simultaneous tri-axial forces, Fx, Fy, and Fz, at the skin interface. Concurrently, a dual wavelength optical reflectance mechanism quantifies skin erythema by capturing subtle variations in hemoglobin absorption. Opaque elastomeric encapsulation shields the internal optics, supporting stable optical measurements under varying ambient illumination and skin conditions. System level integration via near field communication enables untethered operation across a multiplexed sensor network. On-body evaluations in a simulated clinical bed setting demonstrate the ability of the platform to dynamically map posture-dependent biomechanical loading and localized vascular responses, providing a technological basis for future studies on data-driven monitoring of the mechanical and vascular factors associated with pressure-injury risk. Pressure injuries arise from sustained mechanical loading and reduced blood flow, but current tools cannot objectively track both together. Cho et al. built a soft, wireless, battery-free, optoelectronic sensor that simultaneously maps three-axis stress and redness on the body.
papers.summary_ko: 압력 손상 위험을 모니터링하기 위해 기계적 응력과 혈관 반응(홍반)을 동시에 측정하는 무선, 배터리-프리 광전자 피부 센서를 개발한 연구이다. 광학 공동 기반의 변형 감지와 이중 파장 반사율 측정을 결합하여 3축 힘과 피부 홍반을 비접촉으로 정량화했다. 배터리 소재와는 무관한 생체의료 센서 연구이다.
